application_guidance.input_pattern: Fixed real matrix, exact Gaussian sketch, comparison against a singular-value tail after a target index k.
read_original_when: Changing the sketch distribution, using complex matrices or approximate products
Truncating the output to rank k
Needing a self-contained Proof of the deterministic bound or Gaussian pseudoinverse moment
sensitive_conditions: Projection output may have rank k+p
Expectation of norm; no deviation guarantee extracted

complexity_scope.guarantee: Expected error over independent standard Gaussian sketch entries for each fixed real A.
complexity_scope.hidden_constants: The displayed error inequality has the exact factor sqrt(1+k/(p-1)); no hidden multiplicative constants. Computational work estimates are separate asymptotic estimates.
complexity_scope.oracle: Exact products x->Ax suffice to form Y. The analytic projector residual does not imply that an explicit matrix P_Y A is available from those queries alone. Forming Q*A needs separate access, e.g. A* products.
complexity_scope.output_and_metric: Basis of range(Y), or the mathematical projection approximation P_Y A of rank at most k+p; expectation of Frobenius norm residual, not a rank-k output guarantee.
complexity_scope.regime: Integer k,p>=2 and k+p<=min(m,n), exact mathematical sketch/projection.
complexity_scope.resource: ell=k+p products with A; n ell Gaussian draws and orthonormalization separately charged. Explicit Stage B factors require separately charged Q*A formation and optional SVD.
complexity_scope.upper_witness_or_lower_coverage: Selected real Gaussian Algorithm 4.1 with ell=k+p; no lower bound or unrestricted Oracle Complexity claim.

content.intended_use: Upper bound for the expected projection residual of Algorithm 4.1 in its selected real Gaussian regime.

dependencies.role: Deterministic squared Frobenius residual inequality; statement checked, full Proof not reviewed.
Scaled Gaussian Frobenius second moment; statement checked.
Gaussian pseudoinverse Frobenius second moment; statement checked, Appendix/external derivation not reviewed.

proofs.locator: PDF p.57 bottom through p.58 first Proof ending before Proof of Theorem 10.6
map: Source p.57: partition the right singular-vector matrix V=[V_1|V_2] with k and n-k columns, and define Omega_i=V_i*Omega. Orthogonal invariance makes V*Omega standard Gaussian; its disjoint row blocks are independent. Omega_1 has full row rank almost surely.
Source p.57: apply Holder's inequality and Theorem 9.1, Eq.(9.3), to obtain E R <= (E R^2)^{1/2} <= (||Sigma_2||_F^2 + E||Sigma_2 Omega_2 Omega_1^dagger||_F^2)^{1/2}, where R=||(I-P_Y)A||_F.

Source p.58: condition on Omega_1. Proposition 10.1 Eq.(10.1) yields E[||Sigma_2 Omega_2 Omega_1^dagger||_F^2 | Omega_1] = ||Sigma_2||_F^2 ||Omega_1^dagger||_F^2. Independence justifies this conditional Gaussian calculation.
Source p.58: Proposition 10.2 Eq.(10.3) gives E||Omega_1^dagger||_F^2=k/(p-1). Substitute and use ||Sigma_2||_F^2=sum_{j>k}sigma_j^2 to obtain the stated inequality.
proofs.omitted_details: This is a faithful map of the complete source Proof, not a new local Proof. Proofs of the cited deterministic and Gaussian moment results, and their external references, are not independently checked. Source-internal dependency statements are cited through the same Source rather than invented scientific IDs.
proofs.reading_coverage: Actually read and visually checked Theorem 10.5 p.56, its entire source Proof pp.57–58, the setup pp.50–51 and the cited Proposition statements p.55. No complete independent reproof claimed.

assumptions: A is fixed independently of the sketch.
Every entry of Omega is independent N(0,1).
k and p are integers with k>=2, p>=2 and k+p<=min(m,n).
statement.objects_and_definitions: Let A be a fixed real m x n matrix. Put r=min(m,n), and order its singular values sigma_1>=...>=sigma_r>=0. Let ell=k+p, Omega in R^{n x ell}, Y=A Omega, and P_Y be the unique orthogonal projector onto range(Y), whether or not Y has full column rank. ||.||_F is the Frobenius norm.
statement.parameter_domains: m,n positive integers; k,p integers >=2; k+p<=r=min(m,n). No spectral decay, spectral gap or full-rank assumption on A.
statement.quantifiers_and_randomness: For every positive integer m,n, every such fixed A and every admissible integer pair k,p, draw Omega as specified; expectation is solely over Omega.
